There's something around here...
There's no mistake...

Because of my magic, we're able 
to move on...
Isn't there something you should say?

Hm... You should rely on my magic 
from now on...

Rely on my magic from now on. I'll lend you 
my powers...as long as it's not a pain.

Oh, you came here after all. It's plain to see 
this strange thing here is just plain strange.

<CLT=cltMIND>This door is different from the others.
It might be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>From the look of it, I'd guess it's
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It's locked.
It doesn't seem like I can get inside.
Was it cuz of my magic?
Ah, no, I used an item on this object, and—
